notes.title: Dia no longer saves a summary of your intake
notes.body: When you run an intake, Dia no longer records your company name, industry, score or goals for Bash Systems & Services. Your files and Ask DIA chats still aren't kept.

notes.title: Find any action with ⌘K
notes.body: Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows), or use Search actions at the top, to jump to any command. The page also has a cleaner layout, with the time and date at the top.
